# Joseph Chen — josephchendev.com

> Backend engineer · Blockchain · AI · B.S. Computer Science, WGU 2021 · Remote, US-based · Open to work

Joseph Chen is an independent backend engineer who builds production systems in Python, Node.js, Solidity, and AI/LLM pipelines. He operates three live products solo: SecureFlow (AI smart-contract scanner), MemeFactory (Web3 launch agency), and AgentFlow (AI customer support SaaS).
